metadata.definition: An authored comment attached to exactly one bearer; roots annotate an ordinary record and replies attach directly to the root comment.

identity.criterion: Each comment record is a distinct authored utterance even when its body matches another comment.

metadata.definition: An annotation that preserves an independently addressable, integrity-checked citation target for its bearer.

identity.criterion: Each citation record is a distinct annotation even when it targets the same selected evidence as another citation.

metadata.definition: An independently authored, time-qualified declaration or assessment about whose stance an exact body revision or passage expresses or endorses.

identity.criterion: Each attribution is one immutable assertion by one claimant about one subject and one exact target state; corrections create successor records.

metadata.definition: Durable recipient-authored evidence that explicitly satisfies an acknowledgement expectation without changing Message attention state.

identity.criterion: Each acknowledgement evidence record is distinct by record id; the specialized Message operation deterministically reuses one record id for the same recipient and Message.

metadata.definition: A collection whose membership is constituted by records being homed beneath it.

identity.criterion: Each folder record is a distinct collection; membership is constituted by a record being homed there.

metadata.definition: A collection whose membership is constituted by records explicitly added to it.

identity.criterion: Each selection record is a distinct collection; membership is constituted by a record being explicitly added.

metadata.definition: A collection whose membership is computed live from its stored, versioned query over existing records.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same stored query that intensionally defines membership; replacing the query establishes a different collection.

metadata.definition: A document that captures immutable bytes or text as provenance for another record.

identity.criterion: Attachment identity is the external blob binding plus its containing record context.

metadata.definition: A saved presentation whose opaque source body is interpreted by its declared versioned runtime adapter.

identity.criterion: Each artifact record is a distinct saved presentation; runtime source changes preserve the record's durable identity.

kinds.gloss: Shared sketch surface whose scene is an append-only batch stream.

metadata.definition: A document whose scene of notes, shapes, strokes, connectors and record cards is an append-only stream of typed operation batches projected into a current scene.

identity.criterion: Each canvas record is a distinct sketch surface; matching titles or scenes do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: An authored native.mdx.v2 operational definition whose consumers use explicit immutable publication snapshots.

identity.criterion: Each module record is a stable authored source identity; publication events attest immutable releases without becoming records.

metadata.definition: An authored operational recipe interpreted by native.recipe.v1; immutable publications, executions, and derived outputs remain separate identities.

identity.criterion: Each recipe record is one governed authored lineage under the declared recipe interpreter; behaviour-changing publications remain revisions of that Program.

metadata.definition: A document that states the current governed meaning of one glossary term.

identity.criterion: A current agreed definition is identified by its canonical glossary term.

kinds.gloss: Session-continuity briefing for a later inhabitant.

metadata.definition: An authored session-continuity briefing whose body states live position, boundaries, and working instructions for a later inhabitant.

identity.criterion: Each handoff record is a distinct session-continuity briefing; matching titles or content do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: An ordinary authored prose or capture document.

identity.criterion: Each note record is a distinct document; matching titles or content do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: A document whose attachment payload is interpreted as tabular data.

identity.criterion: Sheet identity remains the record identity unless explicitly related otherwise.

metadata.definition: A document whose content is organized as a presentation or slide deck.

identity.criterion: Each slides record is a distinct document; matching titles or content do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: A human individual represented as an enduring referent.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same human individual across changes of name, employment, account or contact details.

metadata.definition: An organized institution or legal body represented as an enduring referent.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same organized body across changes of name, branding, domain or representation.

metadata.definition: An addressed Message whose canonical semantic payload conforms to the plain textual-body contract. Channel and physical media are represented separately; richer Message kinds identify additional semantic payload schemas.

identity.criterion: Each text message is a distinct message occurrence; matching payloads or subjects do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: One claimed realised effect for a particular subject and effective period, represented by the governed atomic impact facet.

identity.criterion: Each impact record denotes one claimed realised effect for one effective occurrence or period; corrections to the same claim preserve record identity.

metadata.definition: An outcome intended to become true once and remain durably true thereafter.

identity.criterion: Each milestone record denotes one desired durable achievement; matching measures, dates or wording do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: An outcome intended to be true at a specified observation time.

identity.criterion: Each target record denotes one desired time-bound state; matching measures, dates or wording do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: An authorised settled choice or commitment among live alternatives.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same authorised choice or commitment across rewrites of its documentation; withdrawal occurs through supersession, revocation or rescission.

metadata.definition: An instituted norm that governs conduct because an authorised actor or process laid it down.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same instituted norm across rewrites of its documentation; withdrawal occurs through supersession, repeal, revocation or rescission.

metadata.definition: An ordinary work item whose completion directly discharges the commitment it records.

identity.criterion: Each task record is a distinct commitment to work; matching titles, descriptions or placement do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: A work item whose achievement is entailed by completion of its constituent child work.

identity.criterion: Each epic record is a distinct commitment to a whole body of work discharged by its parts; magnitude, titles or placement do not establish identity.

metadata.definition: A continuing authored exchange classified by its messages and distinct from any Message reply chain.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same authored exchange across its classified messages; classification does not make member content referentially dependent or grant access.

metadata.definition: A bounded capture of one exchange whose sequence or utterances may be addressed, cited or acted upon.

identity.criterion: Continuity of the same meeting, session or exchange occurrence across exports or representations.

metadata.definition: An annotation that escrows a proposed edit to the record named by its single outgoing part_of link until resolution.

identity.criterion: Each suggestion record is a distinct proposal even when its proposed text matches another.
